name: Divider
summary: A rule between two things. It can carry a label in the middle, drop the rules and keep the label, or stand up as a vertical rule.
summaryZh: 两件事之间的那道线。它可以在中间带一个标签,也可以只留标签不要线,还可以立起来变成一条竖线。

variants.name: Plain
variants.note: No rules — the label on its own.

variants.name: Vertical
variants.note: A vertical rule. It stretches to the height of the row it sits in.

props.name: variant
props.description: Which form of the divider this is. The base class on its own is the horizontal rule with a label in the middle.
props.descriptionZh: 这条分割线是哪一种形态。只写基类就是中间带标签的横线。

a11y.notes: The divider is a rule, not a control: nothing on it is focusable and there is nothing to activate. Give it role="separator" so the division is in the accessibility tree, and aria-orientation="vertical" on the vertical form. A separator does not take its name from its content, so the label between the two rules is still read as ordinary text.
a11y.notesZh: 分割线是一条线,不是一个控件:上面没有可聚焦的东西,也没有可触发的动作。给它 role="separator",这道分隔就进了无障碍树;竖线再加上 aria-orientation="vertical"。separator 不从内容取名,所以两条线中间那个标签还是按普通文字读。

examples.title: Horizontal
examples.description: Two rules with the label between them. The label is the divider's content, so it is read as part of the page.
examples.descriptionZh: 两条线,标签夹在中间。标签是分割线的内容,所以它会跟着页面一起被读到。

examples.title: Plain
examples.description: The plain variant drops both rules and leaves the label alone, for the case where the words should not be interrupted.
examples.descriptionZh: 纯文字这一式去掉两条线,只留标签,用在不想让文字被切断的地方。

examples.title: Vertical
examples.description: The vertical rule is as wide as the mood's border and stretches to the height of the row around it, so it needs a flex parent.
examples.descriptionZh: 竖线宽度就是 mood 的描边宽度,高度跟着所在的那一行走,所以它得放在一个 flex 容器里。

notes: The base divider draws its two rules with pseudo-elements, so the label in the middle is ordinary content — the divider never positions it with anything else. The vertical form hides those pseudo-elements and paints its own rule instead.
notesZh: 基础形态的两条线是用伪元素画的,所以夹在中间的标签就是普通内容 —— 分割线不会用别的方式给它定位。竖线形态把这两个伪元素藏掉,自己画一条线。
